-Closed off the areas that you can not go though with a sign and are boarded up so you know that the areas cant be accessed."NO INVISIBLE WALLS"

-Keypad Looks and works better "Still need to fix the fighting with keyboard and game pad when you toggle the keypad"

- Reworking the Credits and adding people in that have helped the development in one way or another. For example "letsTPKothers" Let me know if you'd like yourt real name in the credits.

notes.title: UPDATE 10/08/2018
notes.content:
New Menu systems, this system now supports keyboard and mouse and game pad."THEY NO LONGER FIGHT OVER CONTROL"...

-Redid all settings menu and now you can see what you select in the menus.

-Added key binding and controller binding and you can edit both.
overall have more control in the menu system.

-Added so much more to the settings, just have a blast playing with them.

"Note" The play now and load game option are being worked on and will not work just yet.

Play Now- This will be a selection of small mini missions or game modes that you can play.

Load Game- Is what it says, this section will bring up older save files encase you have missed-out on achievements or parts of the game that are more randomized then others.  

The Tainted Games Dev Team.
